description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for App Gateway components in the WPEFramework, including resolver, authenticator, responder, and request handler interfaces, as well as the GatewayContext structure.

classes.name: GatewayContext
classes.description: Structure holding request, connection, and application identifiers for gateway operations.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving gateway requests, allowing configuration of resolution paths and request resolution.

classes.name: IAppGatewayAuthenticator
classes.description: Interface for authenticating connections, retrieving session IDs, and checking permission groups.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResponder
classes.description: Interface for responding, emitting notifications, forwarding requests, and managing connection context.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResponder::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for app connection state changes.

classes.name: IAppGatewayRequestHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling app gateway requests.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds additional resolution paths to the gateway.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request based on the provided context, origin, method, and parameters.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates an incoming connection using a session ID.

methods.name: GetSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID for a given application ID.

methods.name: CheckPermissionGroup
methods.description: Checks if an application belongs to a specified permission group.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Sends a response payload for a given context.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits a notification to a given context with a specified method and payload.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Forwards a request to the client with connection ID, request ID, method, and parameters.

methods.name: GetGatewayConnectionContext
methods.description: Retrieves connection context parameters like headers or URL parameters.

methods.name: OnAppConnectionChanged
methods.description: Notification callback for app connection start/stop events.

methods.name: HandleAppGatewayRequest
methods.description: Handles an app gateway request and provides a response.
